title: Create Containerfiles for all 5 distros (ubuntu, debian, fedora, alpine, arch)

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Plan: Create test/containers/ with one Containerfile per distro. Each installs bash, git >= 2.34, openssh-client, tmux. Non-root test user. COPY script and test dir. CMD test/run.sh.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Decision: Alpine Containerfile installs GNU coreutils, grep, and sed alongside BusyBox defaults to avoid compatibility issues with git-harden.sh which relies on GNU extensions.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Delivered: 5 Containerfiles in test/containers/ for ubuntu:24.04, debian:trixie, fedora:42, alpine:3.21, archlinux:base. Each installs bash, git, openssh, tmux, creates non-root testuser, copies script+tests.
